groups.sentence: Instructors may permit or expect students to use AI for drafting, outlines, content development or code tasks.
Students may use AI to generate outlines, first drafts or content for their assignments.
Students may use AI to write small code snippets, starter code or routine code structures.
AI-generated content should not exceed a set share of a student's work, such as 25%.
Students may use AI to help complete assignments or parts of tasks where the course or assignment authorizes it.
Students may submit material containing AI-generated text or code if they cite or document the AI use.
Students may use AI to generate, debug and refine code, with the output reviewed.
Students may use AI to revise their own work, get feedback and develop ideas.
Students may use AI to write code comments and documentation.
Students write code comments in their own words.
Students generate at least three iterations of limited length.
AI tools can help with writing, outlines, and coding problems.
